/**
 * @name System command execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/cmd-exec-list
 */
import python
import semmle.python.Concepts

from SystemCommandExecution cmd
select cmd, "Command execution: " + cmd.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath()

/**
 * @name Risky API use
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/risky-api
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string n
where
  (call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() and n = "urlopen") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() and n = "mktemp") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getACall() and n = "zipfile") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("ast").getMember("literal_eval").getACall() and n = "literal_eval") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree","unpack_archive"]).getACall() and n = "shutil") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember(["_create_unverified_context","create_default_context"]).getACall() and n = "ssl") or
  (call = API::builtin(["eval","exec"]).getACall() and n = "eval") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["chmod","system"]).getACall() and n = "os")
select call, n

/**
 * @name Zip extract and template replace details
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/zip-extract-details
 */
import python

from Call c, string fn
where
  (c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["extract", "extractall", "replace", "rmtree", "chmod"] and fn = c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName())
  and c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/virtualenv/%")
select c, fn + " args=" + count(c.getAnArg()).toString() + " obj=" + c.getFunc().(Attribute).getObject().toString() + " arg0=" + c.getArg(0).toString()
findings.hypothesis: Zip slip / path traversal in extraction and template injection

/**
 * @name Risky calls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/risky-calls-list
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string n
where
  (call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() and n = "urlopen") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getACall() and n = "ZipFile") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("ast").getMember("literal_eval").getACall() and n = "literal_eval") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen","run","check_output","call"]).getACall() and n = "subprocess") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember("rmtree").getACall() and n = "rmtree") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp"]).getACall() and n = "mktemp") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system","popen"]).getACall() and n = "os.system")
select call, n + ": " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + " " + call.asExpr().toString()

/**
 * @name Zip extraction / urlopen / literal_eval / template replace
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/custom-risky
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Call c, string kind
where
  (c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["extractall", "extract"] and kind = "extract")
  or (c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "replace" and c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%activation/via_template.py") and kind = "template-replace")
  or (c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["urlopen", "literal_eval", "rmtree", "loads", "load"] and kind = "call-" + c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName())
  or (c.getFunc().(Name).getId() in ["eval", "exec", "open"] and kind = "builtin-" + c.getFunc().(Name).getId() and not c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("tasks/%"))
select c, kind + " " + c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + ":" + c.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()

/**
 * @name Insecure temp / urlopen / extractall
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/custom-misc
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string kind
where
  (call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() and kind = "mktemp") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember("urlopen").getACall() and kind = "urlopen") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system","popen","chmod","symlink"]).getACall() and kind = "os-call") or
  (call = API::moduleImport("ast").getMember("literal_eval").getACall() and kind = "literal_eval") or
  (call = API::builtin(["eval","exec"]).getACall() and kind = "eval")
select call, kind + " at " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + ":" + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()

/**
 * @name urlopen and ssl context details
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/urlopen-details
 */
import python

from Call c, Function f
where c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%periodic_update.py")
  and f = c.getScope().getScope*().(Function)
  and (c.getFunc().toString().matches("%urlopen%") or c.getFunc().toString().matches("%Popen%") or c.getFunc().toString().matches("%_create_default_https_context%"))
select c, "call in " + f.getName() + ": " + c.toString() + " func=" + c.getFunc().toString()

/**
 * @name Inspect calls in key files
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/inspect-calls
 */
import python

from Call c, string f
where f = c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() and
  (f.matches("%via_template.py") or f.matches("%pip_install/base.py") or f.matches("%util/zipapp.py") or f.matches("%app_data/base.py") or f.matches("%periodic_update.py"))
  and (c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["replace","extract","extractall","urlopen","Popen","write_text","open","unlink","join","loads","load","format"] or c.getFunc().(Name).getId() in ["urlopen","Popen","open"])
select c, f + ":" + c.getLocation().getStartLine() + " " + c.toString() + " args=" + count(c.getAnArg())
findings.hypothesis: Inspect key calls for path traversal / injection

/**
 * @name urlopen and extractall context
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/urlopen-ctx
 */
import python

from Call c, string fn
where
  c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/virtualenv/%") and
  (
    fn = "urlopen" and c.getFunc().(Name).getId() = fn
    or fn = "extractall" and c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = fn
    or fn = "Request" and c.getFunc().(Name).getId() = fn
  )
select c, fn + " | " + c.toString() + " | arg0=" + c.getArg(0).toString() + " | enclosing=" + c.getScope().getName()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect urlopen URL and zip extraction for SSRF/zip slip
